_what: Regular-season games per club per season, as an UPPER-BOUND tripwire for detector 2: rows carried under one year heading that exceed what a season could hold.
_NOT_EVIDENCE: No source_id. Nothing may cite this as evidence. It is a bound for a detector, not a record of any season.
_how_the_bound_is_used: A year heading may legitimately be followed by preseason, regular-season AND postseason rows in one run, so the tripwire is regular_season + 10. That is deliberately generous: it will miss small overruns and will not false-positive on a normal block. A coarse tripwire that never cries wolf is worth more here than a tight one that does.
_pre_1933_is_unknown_not_zero: Before 1933 the NFL had no fixed schedule and clubs played different numbers of games. Those years are UNCHECKED, and the detector reports them as unchecked rather than passing them.
_strike_years_are_real: 1982 is 9 and 1987 is 15. A detector that assumed 16 across the 1980s would call a correct block a violation.
